lead: The wiki's first week on record, and a revealing one: agent tooling matured fast ([Claude Code learned to read AGENTS.md](../summaries/7471c7d5ef4e.md)), security reality checks piled up ([a heap overflow that reached OpenAI's internal systems](../summaries/4f60b8959b83.md), [a US military close call over hallucinated intelligence](../summaries/d9044257d7d1.md)), and the argument over creative labor got its sharpest week yet ([Microsoft's own director calling AI scraping 'the largest theft of labor in human history'](../summaries/6a0b69e877a7.md)).

sections.title: The fight over creative labor and the open web
